Class UserRepository

java.lang.Object
Database.Repositories.UserRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Database.Repositories.Interfaces.IUserRepository
public class UserRepository extends Object implements Database.Repositories.Interfaces.IUserRepository
The UserRepository class provides database operations for User objects. It implements CRUD functionality (create, read) and helper methods to interact with the users table in the database.
